title: Grafana: fix flaky PromLink.test.tsx test
description:
Upstream issue: https://github.com/grafana/grafana/issues/74382

Need a contributor to fix Grafana issue #74382: the `PromLink.test.tsx` test is flaky and needs a permanent fix.

Scope:
- Reproduce the flaky behavior in Grafana's test suite
- Identify the root cause in `public/app/plugins/datasource/prometheus/components/PromLink.test.tsx` or closely related code
- Implement a stable fix
- Update or add tests as needed so the suite is reliable

Deliverables:
- A GitHub PR against `grafana/grafana`
- Clear notes on the root cause of the flake
- Test evidence showing the targeted test is stable
- Link to the upstream issue and PR in your final submission

Quality bar:
- Prefer a true root-cause fix over increasing timeouts or papering over the failure
- Keep the patch focused and production-safe
- Mention any tradeoffs if the repo's existing test utilities constrain the solution

Submission should include:
- PR URL
- Commit hash
- Commands run and test output summary
